text: Read carefully the article by Ravenna Reach about the Olympic Games in the Reading
Booklet Insert. Then answer Section 1, Question 1 on this Question Paper.
Write a letter to Ravenna Reach, expressing your views on what you have read.
You may agree or disagree with the writer’s arguments.
In your letter you should:
• identify and evaluate the writer’s views
• use your own ideas to support your comments on the writer’s views.
Base your letter on what you have read in the article, but be careful to use your own words.
Begin your letter: ‘Dear Ravenna Reach…’.
Write between 1½ and 2 sides, allowing for the size of your handwriting.
Up to 10 marks are available for the content of your answer, and up to 15 marks for the
quality of your writing.

Section 2: Composition
Write about two sides, allowing for the size of your handwriting, on one of the following questions.
Up to 13 marks are available for the content and structure of your answer, and up to 12 marks
for the style and accuracy of your writing.
Argumentative/Discursive Writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
‘There’s no such thing in this world as an easy job.’ Give your views.
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain some of the admirable and less admirable qualities of your age group.
Descriptive Writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe a noisy group of people passing by, and your thoughts and feelings about them at
the time.
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe a place that is very old and has a powerful atmosphere.
Narrative Writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Write a story based on an unusual and exciting secret.
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘One moment she was there, and the next…’. Use this sentence to start your story.
